scope: Run only the frozen serialize-javascript patched post-fix protected holdout to a terminal zero-deferred state.

protected_subject.digest_encoding: Tree digest is SHA-256 of a compact UTF-8 JSON array ordered by relative path; each row contains path, file SHA-256, and byte size.

planning_basis.qualification: Used only to bound operations; pre-fix output does not change post-fix prompts, model, selection, thresholds, grouping, or evidence.

per_batch_breakers.execution_note: Persist and inspect each batch; lower runtime breakers when necessary so remaining aggregate allowances cannot be exceeded.

data_transfer.content: Bounded repository-derived evidence from the frozen protected post-fix snapshot

execution_policy.first_batch: Start one fresh foreground pipeline from the exact frozen post-fix source path.
execution_policy.continuation: If deferred findings remain, use only linked production resume batches for the ingested post-fix repository identity.
execution_policy.sequential_verification: Persist and verify authoritative usage, cost, parent linkage, and pending state after every batch.
execution_policy.terminal_requirement: Stop successfully at zero pending findings; unused authorization expires.
execution_policy.no_tuning: Do not change prompts, model, thresholds, priors, selection, grouping, or evidence based on either protected variant.

stop_conditions: The pinned commit, source path, tree digest, manifest digest, or protected-role metadata changes.
Any provider attempt lacks authoritative usage metadata.
Any batch fails or encounters a transport timeout.
Any aggregate or runtime call, token, dollar, or batch ceiling is reached or would be exceeded.
The post-fix pending queue reaches zero.
excluded: Any new pre-fix execution, tuning, scoring changes, and the offline three-run comparison are not authorized.
next_gate: Merge this receipt, then obtain explicit authorization for its exact protected post-fix evidence transfer and ceilings before reading the keychain or executing.
